notes: 12-PDF-page document = a 10-page filing + a clerk work product + a blank verso. Every page classified from its own printed header, never by ordinal: p1 COVER; pp2-6 SCHEDULE A - Itemized Contributions Received (five sheets); pp7-9 SCHEDULE B - Itemized Expenditures Made (three sheets); p10 SUMMARY PAGE (boxes A / B / C / D / E / F and an UNLETTERED 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)' - the v. 4.20 signature, not the lettered G of the newer 2022 blank); p11 the ELECTIONS DIVISION 'Campaign Financial Disclosure Checklist' - THE CHECKLIST DECOY, carrying zero dollar figures, with TWO staff-reviewed copies on the one sheet (red ticks, 'Staff Signature #1', dated 4/4/22; a magenta-ticked copy, 'Staff Signature #2', dated 4/4/22). It is the OTHER documented checklist revision from the one in this chunk's Diamond filing: this one carries a HOLD box in the header and numbered #1/#2 signature lines, and its Summary-Page sub-list ends 'POSITIVE balance at Close of Reporting Period'. p12 BLANK. So this filing binds a checklist at p11 with the genuine summary at p10 - again the immediately-after pattern, and again located by content. FORM: modern_boxAF, revision 'v. 4.20' printed in the footer of pp1-10; five report types on the cover including 'Seven days preceding Convention', which is the filled radio (index.csv's period label 'Convention' agrees with the page face); the amendment question is answered 'No'. TWO MASTHEAD VINTAGES INSIDE ONE FILING, and they alternate by SHEET, not by section: pp1, 7, 8 and 9 are headed 'Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor' while pp2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 10 are headed 'Amelia Powers Gardner Clerk/Auditor' - the filer of this very report is the Clerk/Auditor named on six of her own sheets, since she held that office while running for Commission Seat A. Cover and schedule blanks were stocked independently; neither predicts the other. SHEETS ARE BOUND OUT OF THE FILER'S OWN FOLIATION ORDER: PDF page 3 is foliated 'Page 4' and PDF page 4 is foliated 'Page 3'. Both are Schedule A sheets so no side was swapped, but it is a live instance of the rule that a page ordinal locates nothing - the record's `page` values are ABSOLUTE PDF pages, and each row's sheet is identified by its own printed subtotal. THREE DATES DISAGREE INSIDE THE DOCUMENT and none was adjudicated: the cover's 'Date of Report' box prints 3/30/2022, the cover's signature Date box prints 04/02/2022, and the footer 'Date of Report' boxes read 3/30/2022 on pp1-5 and 7-8 but 3/31/2022 on pp6, 9 and 10. All transcribed as printed. A STRAY '$100.00' IS PRINTED OUTSIDE THE GRID on PDF p3, up in the top-right white space OVER the ELECTIONS DIVISION logo, above the form's own frame, together with a small 'x' in the top-left corner. It occupies no cell, and the sheet's 15 bands already sum exactly to its printed 7,145.00 subtotal, so it is NOT an entry and was not assigned a slot (the §I2 discipline: take a value only from a cell that exists). REDACTION IS UPSTREAM, PER CELL, AND PARTIAL BY DESIGN: on every contribution row the county blacked out the STREET line and left the city/state/zip line below it in the clear, which is exactly the level this record publishes; the cover's Address block and the Signature block are blacked out too, while the cover's phone and email print in the clear (neither carried). No schedule row is illegible as a result. Two contribution rows print a city and state but no zip, one address cell prints the word 'Anonymous' instead of an address, and two print a District of Columbia address - each noted on its row. PAGE-FACE NAME 'Amelia Powers Gardner' on all ten report pages, matching index.csv; page-face office 'Utah County Commission Seat A'.
